official.toggle: How t' spot a true port
official.domain-heading: True GFTV ports be endin' in globalfurry.tv or gftv.asia
official.domain-body: Read the address from its stern, at the last dot afore the first lone slash. A port endin' in aught else be no GFTV, even if the name be hidin' earlier in the address.
official.trusted-link: The full chart o' true GFTV ports
official.secure-heading: Safe harbours fly the HTTPS flag
official.secure-body: Keep a weather eye out fer a padlock, or https:// at the bow o' the address. Only spill yer personal secrets at a true port over safe waters.

how.title: How a HelloSpot be workin'
how.spot.title: Spy the grin
how.spot.body: Scan the horizon fer the HelloSmile on a card, a lanyard or a sign. Wherever it be, there be a HelloSpot.
how.hello.title: Holler ahoy
how.hello.body: Sail on over an' holler ahoy. No soul at a HelloSpot expects ye t' know a single sailor yet.
how.friend.title: Find a shipmate
how.friend.body: Meet the crew around ye, an' weigh anchor with a mate t' look fer at the next meet.

about.title: Global Furry Television, Arr!
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) be the mightiest furry fandom news ship in all o' Asia, anchored in Singapore.
about.body-2: We show off how the furries be growin', fer all hands t' admire today an' the morrow, an' we keep harbours where folk can learn about an' understand each other.
about.body-3: Sailin' the seven seas from our home port, GFTV's crew be international, multicultural an' speakin' many a tongue.
